title: The door closes today
cta: drsigma.net | 7 days of everything · no card
caption:
Sitting the EMREE on 27 December? Enrolment closes today, 23 December, on the NIHS calendar. Check the portal now, not tonight.

Not ready for the 27th? Use the free calculator on drsigma.net to see which sitting your hours can reach.

Send this to the friend who always says tomorrow.

#EMREE #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors #EMREE2026 #deadline

fact.verified: nihs.uaeu.ac.ae EMREE calendar: enrolment 4 Dec-23 Dec 2026, exam 27 Dec 2026. Checked 18 Nov 2026.
